description: Get the server types a running CDSS cluster's nodes can be changed to (G2 clusters only). ⚠️ On a G3/KVM cluster this returns empty lists rather than an error — use ncloud_cdss_get_node_spec_for_change_g3 there. Note that ncloud_cdss_get_node_spec returns a node's CURRENT spec, which is a different operation from the specs it may be changed to.
name: ncloud_cdss_get_node_product_for_change
